code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    q = deque()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r == 0 or r == h-1 or c == 0 or c == w-1) and grid[r][c] == 0:
                seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == 0 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
    inside={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0 and (r,c) not in seen}
    comps=[]
    while inside:
        start=inside.pop(); comp={start}; q=[start]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in inside:
                    inside.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        side=min(max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
        color=24//side
        comps.append((comp,color))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for comp,color in comps:
        for r,c in comp: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
